The '''Arkanian Cybernetic Research Center''' was a [[Cybernetics/Legends|cybernetics]] research facility. It was destroyed in the [[Great Galactic War]], accounting for a monumental loss of rare materials and data.<ref>{{TORcite|type=crewskill|Scavenging|Blood and Steel}}</ref>
